conventions.name: convention-wg26-sp2025-dimension-organization-type
conventions.requirement: Dimension Organization Type (0020,9311), when present, is TILED_FULL (Type 3, StringEnumValues DimensionOrganizationTypeTILED_FULL).
conventions.source: dicom3tools dciodvfy -profile WG26SP2025 (1.00.snapshot.20260927113651) libsrc/standard/module/vl.tpl:701

conventions.name: convention-wg26-sp2025-focal-planes
conventions.requirement: Total Pixel Matrix Focal Planes (0048,0303) is present (Type 1) with Value 1.
conventions.source: dicom3tools dciodvfy -profile WG26SP2025 (1.00.snapshot.20260927113651) libsrc/standard/module/vl.tpl:702

conventions.name: convention-wg26-sp2025-acquisition-uid
conventions.requirement: dciodvfy warns "AcquisitionUID missing" when Acquisition UID (0008,0017) is absent.
conventions.source: dicom3tools dciodvfy -profile WG26SP2025 (1.00.snapshot.20260927113651) libsrc/standard/module/vl.tpl:704

conventions.name: convention-wg26-sp2025-pyramid-uid
conventions.requirement: dciodvfy warns "PyramidUID missing for Volume or Thumbnail ImageType" when a VOLUME or THUMBNAIL image has no Pyramid UID (0008,0019).
conventions.source: dicom3tools dciodvfy -profile WG26SP2025 (1.00.snapshot.20260927113651) libsrc/standard/module/vl.tpl:705

conventions.name: convention-wg26-sp2025-concatenation-uid
conventions.requirement: Concatenation UID (0020,9161) is absent (Type 1C, Condition Never).
conventions.source: dicom3tools dciodvfy -profile WG26SP2025 (1.00.snapshot.20260927113651) libsrc/standard/module/vl.tpl:707

conventions.name: convention-wg26-sp2025-specimen-type
conventions.requirement: Specimen Description Sequence (0040,0560) has at least one Item, and each has a Specimen Type Code Sequence (0040,059A) of exactly one Item (Type 1, VM 1, Baseline CID 8103).
conventions.source: dicom3tools dciodvfy -profile WG26SP2025 (1.00.snapshot.20260927113651) libsrc/standard/module/vl.tpl:708-711

conventions.name: convention-wg26-sp2025-specimen-preparation
conventions.requirement: In each Specimen Description Item, Specimen Preparation Sequence (0040,0610) has at least one Item, and each of them has at least one Specimen Preparation Step Content Item Sequence (0040,0612) Item (both Type 1, VM 1-n).
conventions.source: dicom3tools dciodvfy -profile WG26SP2025 (1.00.snapshot.20260927113651) libsrc/standard/module/vl.tpl:712-716

conventions.name: convention-wg26-sp2025-primary-anatomic-structure
conventions.requirement: Each Specimen Description Item has a Primary Anatomic Structure Sequence (0008,2228) of at least one Item (Type 1, PrimaryAnatomicStructureMandatoryMacro).
conventions.source: dicom3tools dciodvfy -profile WG26SP2025 (1.00.snapshot.20260927113651) libsrc/standard/module/vl.tpl:717 and module/base.tpl:219-225

conventions.name: convention-wg26-sp2025-annotation-coordinate-type
conventions.requirement: A Microscopy Bulk Simple Annotations object's Annotation Coordinate Type (006A,0001) is 2D.
conventions.source: dicom3tools dciodvfy -profile WG26SP2025 (1.00.snapshot.20260927113651) libsrc/standard/module/vl.tpl:1615

conventions.name: convention-wg26-one-series-per-scan
conventions.requirement: One Series per slide scan: the instances of a Series share one Container Identifier, Barcode Value and Acquisition UID where present, and no Acquisition UID occurs in two Series.
conventions.source: DICOM WG-26 Digital Pathology Connectathon Technical Requirements 2026 (last update 2026/07/31), Acquisition Modality requirement 3 and 3.a

conventions.name: convention-wg26-label-image
conventions.requirement: Each slide Series includes an image with the slide label in its pixel data: a LABEL or OVERVIEW image.
conventions.source: DICOM WG-26 Digital Pathology Connectathon Technical Requirements 2026 (last update 2026/07/31), Acquisition Modality requirement 4 and 4.a

conventions.name: convention-wg26-barcode-value
conventions.requirement: A LABEL or OVERVIEW image of the Series stores the query key read from the label in Barcode Value (2200,0005).
conventions.source: DICOM WG-26 Digital Pathology Connectathon Technical Requirements 2026 (last update 2026/07/31), Acquisition Modality requirement 4.b

conventions.name: convention-wg26-true-color-brightfield
conventions.requirement: Only true color brightfield images: Samples per Pixel (0028,0002) is 3, and each Optical Path Sequence Item of a VOLUME or THUMBNAIL image has Illumination Type (111744, DCM, "Brightfield illumination") or (111741, DCM, "Transmission illumination").
conventions.source: DICOM WG-26 Digital Pathology Connectathon Technical Requirements 2026 (last update 2026/07/31), Acquisition Modality requirement 6

conventions.name: convention-wg26-transfer-syntax
conventions.requirement: Only baseline JPEG (1.2.840.10008.1.2.4.50) and JPEG 2000 (1.2.840.10008.1.2.4.90, 1.2.840.10008.1.2.4.91) Transfer Syntaxes; the top layer of the pyramid and the THUMBNAIL, LABEL and OVERVIEW images may also be uncompressed (1.2.840.10008.1.2, 1.2.840.10008.1.2.1, 1.2.840.10008.1.2.1.98).
conventions.source: DICOM WG-26 Digital Pathology Connectathon Technical Requirements 2026 (last update 2026/07/31), Acquisition Modality requirement 6.b

conventions.name: convention-wg26-lossy-layers
conventions.requirement: "It is expected that only lossy compressed images will be sent for the high-resolution and intermediate resolution layers of the pyramid": a VOLUME layer below the top in JPEG 2000 lossless (1.2.840.10008.1.2.4.90).
conventions.source: DICOM WG-26 Digital Pathology Connectathon Technical Requirements 2026 (last update 2026/07/31), Acquisition Modality requirement 6.b

conventions.name: convention-wg26-pyramid
conventions.requirement: A multi-resolution pyramid: at least two VOLUME layers (distinct Total Pixel Matrix sizes) in the Series.
conventions.source: DICOM WG-26 Digital Pathology Connectathon Technical Requirements 2026 (last update 2026/07/31), Acquisition Modality requirement 7

conventions.name: convention-wg26-pyramid-layers
conventions.requirement: "multiple layers are expected (typically 3 to 5 ...)": a pyramid of two VOLUME layers.
conventions.source: DICOM WG-26 Digital Pathology Connectathon Technical Requirements 2026 (last update 2026/07/31), Acquisition Modality requirement 7.a

conventions.name: convention-wg26-tiled-full
conventions.requirement: Dimension Organization Type (0020,9311) is TILED_FULL and the Per-Frame Functional Groups Sequence (5200,9230) is absent.
conventions.source: DICOM WG-26 Digital Pathology Connectathon Technical Requirements 2026 (last update 2026/07/31), Acquisition Modality requirement 8, 8.a and 8.b

conventions.name: convention-wg26-single-z-plane
conventions.requirement: Only single Z-plane images: no VOLUME or THUMBNAIL image of the Series has a Total Pixel Matrix Focal Planes (0048,0303) Value other than 1, and they share one Total Pixel Matrix Origin Z Offset in Slide Coordinate System (0040,074A). Its absence is reported by convention-wg26-sp2025-focal-planes.
conventions.source: DICOM WG-26 Digital Pathology Connectathon Technical Requirements 2026 (last update 2026/07/31), Acquisition Modality requirement 9

conventions.name: convention-wg26-no-concatenation
conventions.requirement: Concatenations are not used and each pyramid layer is entirely in one SOP Instance: no image of the Series is a Concatenation member, and no two VOLUME images have the same Total Pixel Matrix size.
conventions.source: DICOM WG-26 Digital Pathology Connectathon Technical Requirements 2026 (last update 2026/07/31), Acquisition Modality requirement 10 and 10.a

conventions.name: convention-wg26-icc-single-optical-path
conventions.requirement: The Optical Path Sequence (0048,0105) has a single Item, and it holds a non-empty ICC Profile (0028,2000).
conventions.source: DICOM WG-26 Digital Pathology Connectathon Technical Requirements 2026 (last update 2026/07/31), Acquisition Modality requirement 11

conventions.name: convention-wg26-specimen-preparation
conventions.requirement: Each Specimen Description Item's Specimen Preparation Sequence has coded (Value Type CODE) entries for the fixation (430864009, SCT, "Tissue Fixative"), the embedding (430863003, SCT, "Embedding medium") and, in a step of Processing type (127790008, SCT, "Staining"), the stain (424361007, SCT, "Using substance"), as IHE PaLM DPIA 1.4 Appendix B describes.
conventions.source: DICOM WG-26 Digital Pathology Connectathon Technical Requirements 2026 (last update 2026/07/31), Acquisition Modality requirement 13.a

conventions.name: convention-wg26-specimen-type-sct
conventions.requirement: Specimen Type Code Sequence (0040,059A) Items use SNOMED CT (Coding Scheme Designator SCT), e.g. (119376003, SCT, "Tissue specimen"), not HL7 Table 0487.
conventions.source: DICOM WG-26 Digital Pathology Connectathon Technical Requirements 2026 (last update 2026/07/31), Acquisition Modality requirement 13.a and Acquisition Manager requirement 5.c

conventions.name: convention-wg26-annotation-identity
conventions.requirement: An annotation object has the Patient's Name and Patient ID of the images it references, and is in a different Series.
conventions.source: DICOM WG-26 Digital Pathology Connectathon Technical Requirements 2026 (last update 2026/07/31), Evidence Creator requirement 3

conventions.name: convention-wg26-annotation-study
conventions.requirement: Annotations "should also be in the same Study" as the images they annotate: an annotation object in another Study.
conventions.source: DICOM WG-26 Digital Pathology Connectathon Technical Requirements 2026 (last update 2026/07/31), Evidence Creator requirement 3

conventions.name: convention-wg26-annotation-manufacturer
conventions.requirement: "the Manufacturer and ManufacturerModelName of the annotations should allow for this determination": an annotation object with the Manufacturer and Manufacturer's Model Name of the scanner.
conventions.source: DICOM WG-26 Digital Pathology Connectathon Technical Requirements 2026 (last update 2026/07/31), Evidence Creator requirement 3

conventions.name: convention-ihe-dpia-request-attributes
conventions.requirement: The Request Attributes Sequence (0040,0275) has Items, and each one's Accession Number (0008,0050), Issuer of Accession Number Sequence (0008,0051) and Study Instance UID (0020,000D) are those of the top level ("Same as in top level dataset").
conventions.source: IHE PaLM DPIA Rev. 1.4 (Trial Implementation, 2026-03-06) Appendix B Table B.1-1, Request Attributes Sequence rows

conventions.name: convention-ihe-dpia-specimen-type
conventions.requirement: Each Specimen Description Item has a Specimen Type Code Sequence (0040,059A) Item, mapped from SPM-4.
conventions.source: IHE PaLM DPIA Rev. 1.4 (Trial Implementation, 2026-03-06) Appendix B Table B.1-1, Specimen Type Code Sequence row (SPM-4)

conventions.name: convention-ihe-dpia-collection-step
conventions.requirement: Each Specimen Description Item has a collection step: Processing type (111701, DCM) (17636008, SCT, "Specimen collection") with a DateTime of processing (111702, DCM) from SPM-17 and a coded (17636008, SCT, "Specimen Collection") procedure from SPM-7.
conventions.source: IHE PaLM DPIA Rev. 1.4 (Trial Implementation, 2026-03-06) Appendix B Table B.2-1 item 1

conventions.name: convention-ihe-dpia-fixation-step
conventions.requirement: Each Specimen Description Item has a fixation step: Processing type (9265001, SCT, "Specimen Processing") with a coded (430864009, SCT, "Tissue Fixative").
conventions.source: IHE PaLM DPIA Rev. 1.4 (Trial Implementation, 2026-03-06) Appendix B Table B.2-1 item 2

conventions.name: convention-ihe-dpia-embedding-step
conventions.requirement: Each Specimen Description Item has an embedding step: Processing type (9265001, SCT, "Specimen Processing") with a coded (430863003, SCT, "Embedding medium").
conventions.source: IHE PaLM DPIA Rev. 1.4 (Trial Implementation, 2026-03-06) Appendix B Table B.2-1 item 3

conventions.name: convention-ihe-dpia-staining-step
conventions.requirement: Each Specimen Description Item has at least one staining step: Processing type (127790008, SCT, "Staining") with a coded (424361007, SCT, "Using substance") from OBX-5 of LN 8026-7 "Stain method".
conventions.source: IHE PaLM DPIA Rev. 1.4 (Trial Implementation, 2026-03-06) Appendix B Table B.2-1 items 4 to n

conventions.name: convention-ihe-dpia-step-specimen-identifier
conventions.requirement: Every preparation step has (121041, DCM, "Specimen Identifier") equal to the Item's Specimen Identifier (SPM-2.1) and, when the Issuer of the Specimen Identifier Sequence names one, (111724, DCM, "Issuer of Specimen Identifier") equal to it (SPM-2.2).
conventions.source: IHE PaLM DPIA Rev. 1.4 (Trial Implementation, 2026-03-06) Appendix B Table B.2-1 items 1 to n

conventions.name: convention-ihe-dpia-step-order
conventions.requirement: The steps are in ascending chronological order: collection, then fixation, then embedding, then staining.
conventions.source: IHE PaLM DPIA Rev. 1.4 (Trial Implementation, 2026-03-06) Appendix B Table B.2-1 item numbers, and DICOM PS3.3 2026d C.7.6.22.1.3

conventions.name: convention-ihe-dpia-patient-sex
conventions.requirement: Patient's Sex (0010,0040) is F, M or empty: PID-8 holds only F, M or U (Unknown), and U has no DICOM Value.
conventions.source: IHE PaLM DPIA Rev. 1.4 (Trial Implementation, 2026-03-06) Appendix B Table B.1-1 Patient's Sex row (PID-8) and Table A.4-5

conventions.name: convention-ihe-dpia-accession-study
conventions.requirement: "The Study Instance UID will map 1:1 with the case accession number": across the set, each Study Instance UID has one Accession Number and each Accession Number one Study Instance UID.
conventions.source: IHE PaLM DPIA Rev. 1.4 (Trial Implementation, 2026-03-06) Closed Issues 14A and 14B, and Table A.2-4b

conventions.name: convention-ihe-dpia-barcode-container
conventions.requirement: Barcode Value (2200,0005) "Will have same value as Container Identifier (0040,0512), since used as query key in LAB-81 QPD-3": a Barcode Value that differs from the Container Identifier.
conventions.source: IHE PaLM DPIA Rev. 1.4 (Trial Implementation, 2026-03-06) Appendix B Table B.1-1 Barcode Value row, Example column

conventions.name: convention-ihe-dpia-container-type
conventions.requirement: Container Type Code Sequence (0040,0518) mapped from SAC-47, example (433466003, SCT, "Microscope slide"): absent, empty or another code.
conventions.source: IHE PaLM DPIA Rev. 1.4 (Trial Implementation, 2026-03-06) Appendix B Table B.1-1 Container Type Code Sequence row (SAC-47, SPM-27)

conventions.name: convention-ihe-dpia-label-text
conventions.requirement: Label Text (2200,0002) is "Populated by scanner by scanning slide label and performing OCR": a LABEL image without Label Text.
conventions.source: IHE PaLM DPIA Rev. 1.4 (Trial Implementation, 2026-03-06) Appendix B Table B.1-1 Label Text row

conventions.name: convention-ihe-dpia-single-specimen
conventions.requirement: "only one patient's sample for diagnostic interpretation placed on a given glass slide ... Positive control tissue may optionally be present": more than one Specimen Description Item.
conventions.source: IHE PaLM DPIA Rev. 1.4 (Trial Implementation, 2026-03-06) Closed Issue 7

conventions.name: convention-ihe-dpia-order-numbers-standard-extended
conventions.requirement: Conflict: DPIA maps ORC-2/ORC-3 to Placer and Filler Order Numbers (0040,2016)/(0040,2017) and their Identifier Sequences (0040,0026)/(0040,0027) inside the Request Attributes Sequence ("Not actually in Request Attributes Sequence - optional extension"). The Request Attributes Macro defines none of them, so the object is a Standard Extended SOP Instance; the DICOM checks decide its conformance and ihe-dpia does not require them.
conventions.source: IHE PaLM DPIA Rev. 1.4 Appendix B Table B.1-1 order number rows, and DICOM PS3.3 2026d Table 10-9

conventions.name: convention-ihe-dpia-specimen-type-coding
conventions.requirement: Conflict: DPIA's SPM-4 Specimen Type takes HL7 Table 0487 codes, but the DICOM Specimen Type Code Sequence's Baseline CID 8103 "Anatomic Pathology Specimen Type" is SNOMED CT, as the WG-26 2026 connectathon requires. ihe-dpia accepts any coded Specimen Type and reports codes of another scheme here.
conventions.source: IHE PaLM DPIA Rev. 1.4 Table A.5-4 (SPM-4, HL7 Table 0487) against DICOM PS3.16 2026d CID 8103

conventions.name: convention-ihe-dpia-preparation-order-conflict
conventions.requirement: Conflict: PS3.17 NN.6.2 (informative) says its example "first describes the most recent processing of the slide (staining), then goes back", but PS3.3 C.7.6.22.1.3 (normative) requires "ascending chronological order". The validator follows PS3.3 and reports steps that run newest first here.
conventions.source: DICOM PS3.17 2026d NN.6.2 against PS3.3 2026d C.7.6.22.1.3

conventions.name: convention-ihe-dpia-deidentified-step-identifiers
conventions.requirement: Conflict: the Clean Structured Content Option removes (121041, DCM, "Specimen Identifier") and (111724, DCM, "Issuer of Specimen Identifier") Content Items, which TID 8001 and DPIA Table B.2-1 put in every step. For an object that declares Patient Identity Removed YES with (113104, DCM, "Clean Structured Content Option"), PS3.15 is followed and convention-ihe-dpia-step-specimen-identifier is skipped.
conventions.source: DICOM PS3.15 2026d Table E.3.4-1 against PS3.16 2026d TID 8001 and IHE PaLM DPIA Rev. 1.4 Table B.2-1

conventions.name: convention-ihe-dpia-draft-true-color
conventions.requirement: True Color Tiled Full Single Z Plane Pyramid Option: Photometric Interpretation (0028,0004) is a true color one, RGB, YBR_FULL_422, YBR_ICT or YBR_RCT; monochrome and fluorescence images are outside the option.
conventions.source: IHE PaLM CP-LAB-279 (last update 2026/06/10) X.2.3 and 3.1.4.1.2.2, draft (CP under ballot)

conventions.name: convention-ihe-dpia-draft-pyramid
conventions.requirement: "A multi-resolution pyramid is required": at least two VOLUME layers (distinct Total Pixel Matrix sizes) in the Series.
conventions.source: IHE PaLM CP-LAB-279 (last update 2026/06/10) 3.1.4.1.2.2, draft (CP under ballot)

conventions.name: convention-ihe-dpia-draft-tiled-full
conventions.requirement: "Dimension Organization Type (0020,9311) shall be TILED_FULL and the Per-Frame Functional Groups Sequence (5200,9230) shall not be present."
conventions.source: IHE PaLM CP-LAB-279 (last update 2026/06/10) 3.1.4.1.2.2, draft (CP under ballot)

conventions.name: convention-ihe-dpia-draft-single-z-plane
conventions.requirement: "Only a single pyramid with a single Z-plane shall be present": the VOLUME and THUMBNAIL images of the Series have one Pyramid UID at most, Total Pixel Matrix Focal Planes (0048,0303) 1, and one Total Pixel Matrix Origin Sequence Z Offset in Slide Coordinate System (0040,074A).
conventions.source: IHE PaLM CP-LAB-279 (last update 2026/06/10) 3.1.4.1.2.2, draft (CP under ballot)

conventions.name: convention-ihe-dpia-draft-one-series-per-scan
conventions.requirement: All images of one scan of one slide are in one Series and share the Acquisition UID (0008,0017) where present: one Acquisition UID per Series, and none in two Series.
conventions.source: IHE PaLM CP-LAB-279 (last update 2026/06/10) 3.1.4.1.2.2 and 4.8.4.1.1.1, draft (CP under ballot)

conventions.name: convention-ihe-dpia-draft-pyramid-identity
conventions.requirement: "All of the images in the pyramid shall have the same value for Frame of Reference UID (0020,0052), and, if present, Pyramid UID (0008,0019)": the VOLUME and THUMBNAIL images of the Series.
conventions.source: IHE PaLM CP-LAB-279 (last update 2026/06/10) 3.1.4.1.2.2, draft (CP under ballot)

conventions.name: convention-ihe-dpia-draft-no-concatenation
conventions.requirement: "Concatenations shall not be used": no Concatenation UID (0020,9161), Concatenation Frame Offset Number (0020,9228), In-concatenation Number (0020,9162) or SOP Instance UID of Concatenation Source (0020,0242).
conventions.source: IHE PaLM CP-LAB-279 (last update 2026/06/10) 3.1.4.1.2.2, draft (CP under ballot)

conventions.name: convention-ihe-dpia-draft-offset-table
conventions.requirement: "Either a (non-empty) Basic Offset Table, or an Extended Offset Table, shall be present" in encapsulated Pixel Data.
conventions.source: IHE PaLM CP-LAB-279 (last update 2026/06/10) 3.1.4.1.2.2, draft (CP under ballot)

conventions.name: convention-ihe-dpia-draft-jpeg-baseline
conventions.requirement: JPEG Storage Option: the layers of the pyramid (VOLUME and THUMBNAIL images) are in baseline JPEG, Transfer Syntax 1.2.840.10008.1.2.4.50; LABEL and OVERVIEW images may also be uncompressed.
conventions.source: IHE PaLM CP-LAB-279 (last update 2026/06/10) X.2.2 and 3.1.4.1.2.3, draft (CP under ballot)

conventions.name: convention-ihe-dpia-draft-completion-series
conventions.requirement: Acquisition Complete Option: a KOS titled (113034, DCM, "Complete Acquisition Content") is "in a new Series of the referenced images' Study".
conventions.source: IHE PaLM CP-LAB-281 (last update 2026/06/10) 3.nn3.4.1.2, draft (CP under ballot)

conventions.name: convention-ihe-dpia-draft-completion-whole-images
conventions.requirement: "References to multi-frame images shall reference the entire image, and not selected frames": no Referenced Frame Number (0008,1160) or Referenced Segment Number (0062,000B) in the completion KOS.
conventions.source: IHE PaLM CP-LAB-281 (last update 2026/06/10) 3.nn3.4.1.2, draft (CP under ballot)

conventions.name: convention-ihe-dpia-draft-completion-identity
conventions.requirement: The completion KOS has "the same Patient, Study and Specimen identifying and descriptive information that is present in the referenced images": Patient's Name, Patient ID, Birth Date and Sex, Study Instance UID and Accession Number equal, and Container Identifier and Specimen Identifiers equal where the KOS carries them.
conventions.source: IHE PaLM CP-LAB-281 (last update 2026/06/10) 3.nn3.4.1.2, draft (CP under ballot)

conventions.name: convention-ihe-dpia-draft-completion-references
conventions.requirement: The completion KOS lists "the complete set of images ... for a single acquisition (scan) of a single slide": its Current Requested Procedure Evidence Sequence references one Series, every VL WSI image of that Series in the validated set, and every image its IMAGE Content Items reference.
conventions.source: IHE PaLM CP-LAB-281 (last update 2026/06/10) X.2.4 and 3.nn34.6.3, draft (CP under ballot)

conventions.name: convention-ihe-dpia-draft-completion-specimen-standard-extended
conventions.requirement: Conflict: CP-LAB-281 asks the completion KOS for the Specimen information of the images, but the KOS IOD of the pinned edition has no Specimen Module, so Specimen Attributes make it a Standard Extended SOP Instance until DICOM CP-2656 adds the Module. The Patient and Study information is required; the Specimen information is compared only where the KOS carries it.
conventions.source: IHE PaLM CP-LAB-281 3.nn3.4.1.2, draft (CP under ballot), against the DICOM PS3.3 2026d A.35.4 Key Object Selection Document IOD; DICOM CP-2656 (Assigned)

conventions.name: convention-interop-dmv-frame-of-reference
conventions.requirement: The viewer throws "Images of pyramid must all have the same Frame of Reference UID.": VOLUME images of one Series with different or missing Frame of Reference UIDs.
conventions.source: dicom-microscopy-viewer 0.49.5 src/pyramid.js:111-115

conventions.name: convention-interop-dmv-container
conventions.requirement: The viewer throws "Images of pyramid must all have the same Container Identifier.": VOLUME images of one Series with different Container Identifiers.
conventions.source: dicom-microscopy-viewer 0.49.5 src/pyramid.js:116-120

conventions.name: convention-interop-dmv-channels
conventions.requirement: The viewer throws "Images of pyramid must all have the same number of channels": VOLUME images of one Series with different Number of Optical Paths (0048,0302).
conventions.source: dicom-microscopy-viewer 0.49.5 src/pyramid.js:132-138

conventions.name: convention-interop-split-layer
conventions.requirement: Both tools refuse a layer spread over several VOLUME images of the same Total Pixel Matrix size unless they are members of one Concatenation ("are not part of a concatenation either", "Slide contains unexpected image").
conventions.source: dicom-microscopy-viewer 0.49.5 src/pyramid.js:174-181; OpenSlide 4.0.1 src/openslide-vendor-dicom.c:776-792

conventions.name: convention-interop-dmv-focal-planes
conventions.requirement: The viewer throws "Images with multiple focal planes are not yet supported." when Number of Focal Planes (0048,0013), the planes of an extended depth of field image, exceeds 1.
conventions.source: dicom-microscopy-viewer 0.49.5 src/metadata.js:120-122

conventions.name: convention-interop-icc-first-optical-path
conventions.requirement: Both tools read the ICC Profile from Optical Path Sequence Item 1 only ("ICC Profile was not found for image"): a color VOLUME image whose first Optical Path Item has no ICC Profile.
conventions.source: dicom-microscopy-viewer 0.49.5 src/pyramid.js:35-50; OpenSlide 4.0.1 src/openslide-vendor-dicom.c:531-539

conventions.name: convention-interop-openslide-transfer-syntax
conventions.source: OpenSlide 4.0.1 src/openslide-vendor-dicom.c:146-156 and 880-887

conventions.name: convention-interop-openslide-pixel-format
conventions.requirement: OpenSlide requires Planar Configuration 0, Bits Allocated 8, Bits Stored 8, High Bit 7, Samples per Pixel 3, Pixel Representation 0, and Total Pixel Matrix Focal Planes 1 when present.
conventions.source: OpenSlide 4.0.1 src/openslide-vendor-dicom.c:889-898

conventions.name: convention-interop-openslide-photometric
conventions.requirement: OpenSlide fails with "Unsupported photometric interpretation" unless it is RGB, or YBR_FULL_422 for JPEG, YBR_ICT or YBR_RCT for JPEG 2000, YBR_RCT for JPEG 2000 lossless.
conventions.source: OpenSlide 4.0.1 src/openslide-vendor-dicom.c:907-936

conventions.name: convention-interop-openslide-associated-images
conventions.requirement: OpenSlide fails with "Slide contains unexpected associated image" for a second LABEL, OVERVIEW or THUMBNAIL image of a slide, and with "Found associated image as a concatenation member".
conventions.source: OpenSlide 4.0.1 src/openslide-vendor-dicom.c:650-654 and 680-694

conventions.name: convention-interop-slim-transfer-syntax
conventions.source: Slim 0.46.10 DICOM Conformance Statement DCS.md:223-237

conventions.name: convention-interop-orthanc-modality
conventions.requirement: Orthanc skips "a DICOM instance that is not part of a whole-slide image" unless its Modality (0008,0060) is SM.
conventions.source: Orthanc WSI plugin 4.0 (2026-09-10) DicomPyramidInstance.cpp:182-186 and DicomPyramid.cpp:118

conventions.name: convention-interop-orthanc-base-consistency
conventions.requirement: Orthanc warns "Inconsistency of imaged volume width/height in series" and "Inconsistency of objective lens power in series" when the instances of the finest level disagree.
conventions.source: Orthanc WSI plugin 4.0 (2026-09-10) DicomPyramid.cpp:270-330

conventions.name: convention-interop-orthanc-sparse-tiles
conventions.requirement: Orthanc drops a Frame "with unexpected tile location" whose Plane Position (Slide) is not a multiple of the tile size plus 1, or lies outside the Total Pixel Matrix.
conventions.source: Orthanc WSI plugin 4.0 (2026-09-10) DicomPyramidInstance.cpp:225-247

conventions.name: convention-interop-metadata-sequence-size
conventions.requirement: "DICOM sequence tags containing more than approximately 1 MiB of data will not be returned in metadata resources": a top-level Sequence of at least 1 MiB, typically the Per-Frame Functional Groups Sequence of a TILED_SPARSE image.
conventions.source: NCI Imaging Data Commons, learn.canceridc.dev/data/data-known-issues; Google Cloud Healthcare API DICOM conformance statement (updated 2026-10-20)

conventions.name: convention-interop-idc-index
conventions.requirement: The IDC slide index reads Objective Lens Power from Optical Path Sequence Item 1 and Pixel Spacing from the Shared Functional Groups: a VOLUME image lacking either leaves them empty in the index.
conventions.source: idc-index-data assets/sm_index.sql:25-31 (commit 45b17c9fc22f)

conventions.name: convention-interop-wsidicom-tile-size
conventions.requirement: "Levels are required to have ... same tile size": VOLUME layers of one Series with different Rows or Columns.
conventions.source: wsidicom 0.36.1 README.md:33 and wsidicom/config.py:42-44 (strict_tile_size_check)

conventions.name: convention-interop-wsidicom-scale
conventions.requirement: "Levels are required to have (close to) 2 factor scale": a VOLUME layer whose Pixel Spacing over the base layer's is more than a tenth of a doubling (log2 0.1, about 7%) from a power of two, the validator's reading of "close to".
conventions.source: wsidicom 0.36.1 README.md:33

conventions.name: convention-interop-wsidicom-origin
conventions.requirement: wsidicom splits instances whose Total Pixel Matrix Origins are more than pyramids_origin_threshold = 0.02 mm apart into separate pyramids: VOLUME layers of one Series that far apart.
conventions.source: wsidicom 0.36.1 wsidicom/config.py:54 and wsidicom/series/pyramids.py:117-150

conventions.name: convention-interop-highdicom-offset-table
conventions.requirement: "Without an offset table, the potential speed benefits of using lazy frame retrieval are usually eliminated": multi-frame encapsulated Pixel Data with an empty Basic Offset Table and no Extended Offset Table.
conventions.source: highdicom 0.28.2 docs/image.rst:296-304

conventions.name: convention-interop-dciodvfy-pyramid-uid-label
conventions.requirement: dciodvfy warns "Pyramid UID present in LABEL or OVERVIEW image".
conventions.source: dicom3tools dciodvfy (1.00.snapshot.20260927113651) appsrc/dcfile/dciodvfy.cc:4146-4164

conventions.name: convention-interop-dciodvfy-single-frame
conventions.requirement: dciodvfy reports an error unless Number of Frames (0028,0008) is 1 for Image Type Value 3 LOCALIZER, THUMBNAIL, LABEL or OVERVIEW.
conventions.source: dicom3tools dciodvfy (1.00.snapshot.20260927113651) libsrc/standard/module/vl.tpl:566

conventions.name: convention-interop-dciodvfy-imaged-volume
conventions.requirement: dciodvfy warns "ImagedVolumeWidth inconsistent with TotalPixelMatrixColumns and PixelSpacing" (and Height) when Imaged Volume Width or Height differs from Total Pixel Matrix Columns or Rows times the shared Pixel Spacing by a relative 0.001 or more.
conventions.source: dicom3tools dciodvfy (1.00.snapshot.20260927113651) appsrc/dcfile/dciodvfy.cc:3612-3670

conventions.name: convention-interop-associated-frame-of-reference
conventions.requirement: Conflict: the A.1.2.30 Note lets LABEL, OVERVIEW and THUMBNAIL images accompany a pyramid in its Series "if they share the same Frame of Reference (but not otherwise ...)", while normative Table A.32.8-1 requires the Frame of Reference Module only for VOLUME and THUMBNAIL images. The normative table is followed, so DICOM validation passes a LABEL or OVERVIEW image without a Frame of Reference UID in the pyramid's Series; a consumer reading the Note may not associate it.
conventions.source: DICOM PS3.3 2026d A.1.2.30 Note against Table A.32.8-1 (CP-2406)

conventions.name: convention-interop-xyb-photometric
conventions.requirement: Conflict: the scanner writes Photometric Interpretation XYB for JPEG XL, but the C.8.12.4.1.5 Enumerated Values for VL WSI are MONOCHROME2, RGB, YBR_FULL_422, YBR_ICT and YBR_RCT. The normative list is followed, so DICOM validation fails such an image; the C.8.12.4.1.5 Note anticipates new values for new Transfer Syntaxes, and no CP adds XYB yet.
conventions.source: DICOM PS3.3 2026d C.8.12.4.1.5 against the Philips Pathology Scanner SGi 1.0 DICOM Conformance Statement (Doc 8001001301)

disposition.detail: Binds applications using coded entries; the validator complies: it matches coded entries by Coding Scheme Designator with Code Value, Long Code Value or URN Code Value, never by Code Meaning

requirements.text: Hence the Value of Code Meaning (0008,0104) shall never be used as a key, index or decision value, rather the combination of Coding Scheme Designator (0008,0102) and Code Value (0008,0100), Long Code Value (0008,0119), or URN Code Value (0008,0120) may be used.

The following constraints on the encoding of the ICC Profile shall be observed:
The profile shall be of the Input Device class, i.e., header bytes 12 through15, Profile Device/Class Signature, shall be "scnr"

The color space of the input shall be RGB, i.e., header bytes 16 through 19, Color Space Signature, shall be "RGB", regardless of the Photometric Interpretation of the image pixel data prior to decompression
PCS shall be CIELab or CIEXYZ, i.e., header bytes 20 through 23, Profile Connection Space, shall be either "Lab" or "XYZ".

The Data Elements Signed Attribute shall list the Tags of the Data Elements that are included in the MAC calculation.
The Tags listed shall reference Data Elements at the same level as the Mac Parameters Sequence (4FFE,0001) Data Element in which the Data Elements Signed Attribute appears.
Tags included in Data Elements Signed shall be listed in the order in which they appear within the Data Set.
The following Data Elements shall not be included either implicitly or explicitly in the list of Tags in Data Elements Signed, nor included as part of the MAC calculation:

If any of the Data Element Tags in the list refer to a Sequence of Items, then the Tags of all Data Elements within all Items of that Sequence shall be implicitly included in the list of Data Elements Signed, except those disallowed above.
This implicit list shall also include the Item Tag (FFFE,E000) Data Elements that separate the Sequence Items and the Sequence Delimitation Item (FFFE,E0DD).

For Data Elements with a VR OB (e. g. pixel data) that have an undefined length (i.e., the data is encapsulated as described in PS3.5 PS3.5), the Item Data Element Tags that separate the fragments shall implicitly be included in the list of Data Elements Signed (i.e., a Data Element with a VR of OB is encoded in the same fashion as a Sequence of Items).

To generate the MAC, Data Elements referenced either explicitly or implicitly by the Tags in the Data Elements Signed (0400,0020) list shall be encoded using the Transfer Syntax identified by the MAC Calculation Transfer Syntax UID (0400,0010) of the MAC Parameters Sequence (0400,0010) Item where the Data Elements Signed (0400,0020) appears.
Data shall be formed into a byte stream and presented to the algorithm specified by MAC Algorithm (0400,0015) for computation of the MAC according to the following rules:

For all Data Elements except those with a VR of SQ or with a VR of OB with an undefined length, all Data Element fields, including the Tag, the VR, the reserved field (if any), the Value Length, and the Value, shall be placed into the byte stream in the order encountered.
The Value Length shall not be included.

After all the Items have been incorporate into the byte stream, a Sequence Delimitation Item Tag (FFFE,E0DD) shall be added to the byte stream presented to the MAC Algorithm, regardless of whether or not it was originally present.

After the fields of all the Data Elements in the Data Elements Signed list have been placed into the byte stream presented to the MAC Algorithm according to the above rules, all of the Data Elements within the Digital Signatures Sequence Item except the Certificate of Signer (0400,0115), Signature (0400,0120), Certified Timestamp Type (0400,0305), and Certified Timestamp (0400,0310) shall also be encoded according to the above rules, and presented to the MAC algorithm (i.e., the Attributes of the Digital Signature Sequence Item for this particular Digital Signature are also implicitly included in the list of Data Elements Signed, except as noted above).

disposition.detail: The embedded Encrypted Attributes Data Sets are enveloped for recipients whose private keys are not in the file, so their Values cannot be compared

requirements.text: However, if the same Attribute is contained in more than one embedded Encrypted Attributes Data Set, the value of the Attribute must be identical in all embedded Encrypted Attributes Data Sets in which the Attribute is contained.
References to unencapsulated HL7 Structured Documents from within DICOM SOP Instances shall be encoded with a SOP Class UID and SOP Instance UID pair.

The Abstract Syntax of an HL7 Structured Document is defined by its Hierarchical Message Description; the Object Identifier of the Hierarchical Message Description shall be used as the SOP Class UID for the Structured Document reference.

disposition.detail: The HL7 II identifier is in the referenced HL7 document, outside the validated set; the file holds only the UID, so their mapping cannot be checked

requirements.text: Therefore a UID shall be constructed for use within the DICOM Data Set that can be mapped to the native instance identifier encoded as an HL7 II Data Type.
For Data Elements with a fixed multiplicity, this Attribute shall contain a single integer value, e.g., 3.
The stride is not permitted to be 0.

For a Private Data Element Value Representation (0008,030A) of SQ, the multiplicity shall be 1 and the allowed number of Items in a Sequence is recorded in Private Data Element Number of Items(0008,030B).
For Sequences that permit a fixed number of Items, this Attribute shall contain a single integer value, e.g., 3.
Leading space characters shall not be present.
The offset for UTC shall be +0000; -0000 shall not be used.

The following assumptions shall be made and the following restrictions shall apply:
The primary set of Control Characters shall always be designated as the C0 code element and this shall be invoked in the CL area of the code table.

The Fractional Second component, if present, shall contain 1 to 6 digits.
If Fractional Second is unspecified the preceding "." shall not be included.
The offset suffix, if present, shall contain 4 digits.
Leading and embedded spaces are not allowed.
The YYYY component shall not be null.
Non-trailing null components are prohibited.
The offset for a Date Time Value in UTC shall be +0000.
A string of characters representing an Integer in base-10 (decimal), shall contain only the characters 0 - 9, with an optional leading "+" or "-".
The integer, n, represented shall be in the range:
The character code 5CH (the BACKSLASH "\" in ISO-IR 6) shall not be present, as it is used as the delimiter between Values in multi-valued Data Elements.
The string shall not have Control Characters except for ESC.
Data Elements with this VR shall not be multi-valued and therefore character code 5CH (the BACKSLASH "\" in ISO-IR 6) may be used.
The octet-stream shall be padded with a single trailing NULL byte value (00H) when necessary to achieve even length.

disposition.detail: Another character meant as the component delimiter is indistinguishable from name text; only '^' splits components, and the component count it implies is checked as its own statement

requirements.text: The component delimiter shall be the caret "^" character (5EH).
There shall be no more than four component delimiters, i.e., none after the last component if all components are present.
The remaining components are not used and shall not be present.

disposition.detail: Another character meant as the component group delimiter is indistinguishable from name text; only '=' splits groups, and the group count and lengths it implies are checked as their own statements

requirements.text: The delimiter for component groups shall be the equals character "=" (3DH).
There shall be no more than two component group delimiters, i.e., none after the last component group if all component groups are present.
The character code 05CH (the BACKSLASH "\" in ISO-IR 6) shall not be present, as it is used as the delimiter between Values for multi-valued Data Elements.
The string shall not have Control Characters except ESC.
The FFFFFF component, if present, shall contain 1 to 6 digits.
If FFFFFF is unspecified the preceding "." shall not be included.

If a Value Field containing one or more UIDs is an odd number of bytes in length, the Value Field shall be padded with a single trailing NULL (00H) character to ensure that the Value Field is an even number of bytes in length.
Leading spaces are not allowed.

disposition.detail: Binds readers to ignore the trailing spaces of a UR Value; the validator complies: the UR format check trims them first

requirements.text: Trailing spaces shall be ignored.
Data Elements with this VR shall not be multi-valued.
Characters outside the permitted character set must be "percent encoded".

disposition.detail: Another character meant as the component group delimiter is indistinguishable from name text; only '=' splits groups, and the group count and lengths it implies are checked as their own statements

requirements.text: The delimiter of the component group shall be the equals character "=" (3DH).
The first component group (identified by DICOM as "alphabetic") shall be encoded using the character set specified by Specific Character Set (0008,0005), Value 1.

If Attribute Specific Character Set (0008,0005) is not present, the Default Character Repertoire ISO-IR 6 shall be used. [biblio_ISOIEC2022] escapes for Code Extension shall not be used in this component group.

When Specific Character Set (0008,0005) Value 1 specifies a multi-byte character set without Code Extension (i.e., Unicode in UTF-8, [biblio_GB18030] or [biblio_GBK]), the characters of this component group may be encoded with multiple bytes, but shall be drawn from the code points U+0020 through U+1FFF of [biblio_ISOIEC10646], or the following [biblio_ISOIEC10646] code points:

disposition.detail: Whether a component group is the ideographic (second) or phonetic (third) representation is linguistic: Korean names, for instance, put Hangul in the ideographic group (PS3.5 Annex I), so no character class decides it

requirements.text: The second group shall be used for ideographic characters.

disposition.detail: Whether a component group is the ideographic (second) or phonetic (third) representation is linguistic: Korean names, for instance, put Hangul in the ideographic group (PS3.5 Annex I), so no character class decides it

requirements.text: The third group shall be used for phonetic characters.
The character sets used shall be those from Attribute Specific Character Set (0008,0005), Value 1 through n, and may use [biblio_ISOIEC2022] escapes.
If Attribute Specific Character Set (0008,0005), Value 1 is not present, the Default Character Repertoire ISO-IR 6 shall be used.

At the end of the Value of the Person Name Data Element, and before the component delimiters "^" and "=", the character set shall be switched to the Default Character Repertoire ISO-IR 6, if Value 1 of Specific Character Set (0008,0005) is not present.
If Value 1 of Specific Character Set (0008,0005) is present, the character set shall be switched to that specified by Value 1 of the Attribute.

Each combining character (e.g., diacritics or vowel marks) shall be considered a separate character for this maximum length, regardless of how an application may display such combining characters (i.e., combined into the glyph for the base character, or rendered separately).

The Unknown (UN) VR shall only be used for Private Data Elements and Standard Data Elements previously encoded as some DICOM VR other than UN using Implicit VR encoding, and whose Value Representation is currently unknown, or whose known Value Representation is one of those that have a 16-bit Value Length Field (see Section 7.1.2) when using Explicit VR encoding and whose Value Length exceeds 65534 (216-2).

disposition.detail: Binds applications that convert byte order not to swap UN Values; a stored UN Value's bytes cannot show whether they were swapped

requirements.text: As long as the VR is unknown the Value Field is insensitive to byte ordering and shall not be 'byte-swapped' (see Section 7.3).
In the case of Undefined Length Sequences, the Value shall remain in Implicit VR form.
The UN VR shall not be used for Private Creator Data Elements (i.e., the VR is equal to LO, see Section 7.8.1).
The UN VR shall not be used for File Meta Information Data Elements (any Tag (0002,xxxx), see PS3.10 PS3.10).
The URI/URL (UR) VR uses a subset of the Default Character Repertoire as defined in [biblio_RFC_3986], and shall not use any code extension or replacement techniques.

URI/URL domain name components that in their original form use characters outside the permitted character set shall use the Internationalized Domain Names for Applications encoding in accordance with IETF RFC5890 and RFC5891.

Other URI/URL content that uses characters outside the permitted character set shall use the Internationalized Resource Identifiers encoding mechanism of IETF RFC 3987, representing the content string in UTF-8 and percent encoding characters as required.

disposition.detail: Conformance Statement content, and what an implementer's new Defined Term means, are not in the file

requirements.text: These new Values shall be specified in the Conformance Statement (see PS3.2 PS3.2) and shall not have the same meaning as currently defined Values in this Standard.

disposition.detail: Binds receivers and validators not to reject Values outside the Defined Terms; the validator complies: of the Values the Standard lists, only Enumerated Values are enforced

requirements.text: A Data Element with Defined Terms that does not contain a Value equivalent to one of the Values currently specified in this Standard shall not be considered to have an invalid Value.
An empty (zero length) Value is not a valid new Value for a Defined Term; empty Values shall be considered invalid unless the Standard specifically permits empty Values.

disposition.detail: What an implementer-defined Value means, e.g. unknown, is not encoded

requirements.text: New Values shall not have a meaning of unknown, since that concept, if permitted by the Standard, shall be conveyed explicitly either by allowing the Data Element to be zero length or by provision of a standard Defined Term with such a meaning.

disposition.detail: Binds comparisons with IS and DS Defined Terms to their numeric meaning; the validator complies: it compares those Values numerically

requirements.text: For string Value Representations (IS and DS), the meaning of the Value in the Standard shall be used, not the literal string.

disposition.detail: A notation rule for the VM column of the Standard's own tables, not a property of encoded Values

requirements.text: If the number of Values that may be encoded in a Data Element is variable, it shall be represented by two numbers separated by a dash; e.g., "1-10" means that there may be 1 to 10 Values in the Data Element.
When a Data Element has multiple Values, those Values shall be delimited as follows:
For character strings, the character 5CH (BACKSLASH "\" in the case of the repertoire ISO IR-6) shall be used as a delimiter between Values.
Multiple binary Values of fixed length shall be a series of concatenated Values without any delimiter.
Each string Value in a multi-valued character string may be of even or odd length, but the length of the entire Value Field (including "\" delimiters) shall be of even length.

If padding is required to make the Value Field of even length, a single padding character shall be applied to the end of the Value Field (to the last Value), in which case the length of the last Value may exceed the length of Value by 1.

Only the last UID Value in a multi-valued Data Element with a VR of UI shall be padded with a single trailing NULL (00H) character when necessary to ensure that the entire Value Field (including "\" delimiters) is of even length.
Data Elements with a VR of LT, OB, OD, OF, OL, OV, OW, SQ, ST, UN, UR or UT shall always have a Value Multiplicity of one.
The Data Elements in a Data Set shall be ordered by increasing Data Element Tag Number and shall occur at most once in a Data Set.
A Data Element shall have one of three structures.
Implicit and Explicit VR Data Elements shall not coexist in a Data Set and Data Sets nested within it (see Section 7.5).
The VR for a given Data Element Tag shall be as defined by the Data Dictionary as specified in PS3.6 PS3.6.
The two byte VR shall be encoded using only upper case letters from the DICOM default character set.
The VR of Standard Data Elements shall agree with those specified in the Data Dictionary.
If the VM is greater than one, multiple Values shall be delimited within the Value Field as defined previously in Section 6.4.
When using the Explicit VR structures, the Data Element shall be constructed of four consecutive fields: Data Element Tag, VR, Value Length, and Value.
The value of the Value Length Field shall equal the length of the Value Field.
These reserved bytes shall be set to 0000H and shall not be used or decoded (Table 7.1-1).

for VRs of OB, SQ and UN, if the Value Field has an Explicit Length, then the Value Length Field shall contain a value equal to the length (in bytes) of the Value Field, otherwise, the Value Field has an Undefined Length, the Value Field will consist of Item Elements, and a Sequence Delimitation Item will be present at the end of the Value Field.
for all other VRs with a 32-bit Value Length Field, the Value Length Field shall contain a value equal to the length (in bytes) of the Value Field.
When using the Implicit VR structure the Data Element shall be constructed of three consecutive fields: Data Element Tag, Value Length, and Value (see Table 7.1-3).
If the Value Field has an Explicit Length then the Value Length Field shall contain a value equal to the length (in bytes) of the Value Field.

All implementations shall be able to parse Group Length Data Elements, and may discard and not insert or re-insert them; if present they shall be consistent with the encoding of the Data Set even if the Transfer Syntax is changed resulting in a change in the actual length of a group of Data Elements.

disposition.detail: Binds implementations not to require Group Length elements. The validator complies: outside group 0002, where PS3.10 Table 7.1-1 makes (0002,0000) Type 1, a Group Length is only checked when present

requirements.text: No implementation shall require the presence of Group Length Data Elements.

In a binary number consisting of multiple bytes (e.g., a 32-bit unsigned integer value, the Group Number, the Element Number, etc.), the least significant byte shall be encoded first; with the remaining bytes encoded in increasing order of significance.

disposition.detail: Binds every AE to support the default Transfer Syntax; support is not a property of a stored file

requirements.text: The default DICOM Transfer Syntax, which shall be supported by all AEs, uses Little Endian encoding and is specified in Section A.1.

disposition.detail: Binds how Big Endian machines process Little Endian Data Sets; processing is not recorded in the file

requirements.text: In the case of Little Endian encoding, Big Endian Machines interpreting Data Sets shall do 'byte swapping' before interpreting or operating on certain Data Elements.
IODs and SOP Classes define Type 1 Data Elements that shall be included and are mandatory Data Elements.
The Value Field shall contain valid data as defined by the Data Element's VR and VM as specified in PS3.6 PS3.6.
The Length of the Value Field shall not be zero.
IODs and SOP Classes define Data Elements that shall be included under certain specified conditions.
When the specified conditions are not met, Type 1C Data Elements shall not be included in the Data Set unless it is specified that they may be present otherwise.
IODs and SOP Classes define Type 2 Data Elements that shall be included and are mandatory Data Elements.
If the Value is known the Value Field shall contain that Value as defined by the Data Element's VR and VM as specified in PS3.6 PS3.6.
These Data Elements shall be included in the Data Set and their absence is a protocol violation.
When the specified conditions are not met, Type 2C Data Elements shall not be included in the Data Set unless it is specified that they may be present otherwise.
Type 3 Data Elements may also be encoded with zero length and no Value, except for SQ Data Elements, which shall not be present with zero Items.

disposition.detail: Binds readers, this validator included, to read a zero-length Type 3 element as absent; a file cannot break it. The encoding and codestream checks treat a zero-length Value as absent

requirements.text: The meaning of a zero length Type 3 Data Element shall be precisely the same as that Data Element being absent from the Data Set.

When an IOD defines a Sequence Data Element (see Section 7.5), the Type of the Sequence Attribute defines whether the Sequence Attribute itself must be present, and the Attribute Description of the Sequence Attribute may define whether and how many Items shall be present in the Sequence.
The VR identified "SQ" shall be used for Data Elements with a Value consisting of a Sequence of zero or more Items, where each Item contains a set of Data Elements.

disposition.detail: Defines Items as an ordered set referenced by ordinal position; an encoded Sequence is ordered by construction, so no file can break it

requirements.text: Items present in an SQ Data Element shall be an ordered set where each Item may be referenced by its ordinal position.

disposition.detail: Defines the implicit ordinal of each Item, counted from 1; ordinals are not encoded, so no file can break it

requirements.text: Each Item shall be implicitly assigned an ordinal position starting with the Value 1 for the first Item in the Sequence, and incremented by 1 with each subsequent Item.

disposition.detail: Follows from the implicit ordinal numbering of Items; ordinals are not encoded, so no file can break it

requirements.text: The last Item in the Sequence shall have an ordinal position equal to the number of Items in the Sequence.

disposition.detail: SQ defines one Sequence Value regardless of its Item count; an intended different Value Multiplicity is not encoded

requirements.text: Data Elements with a VR of SQ may contain multiple Items but shall always have a Value Multiplicity of one (i.e., a single Sequence).

However, the Data Set within the Value Field of the Data Element Item (FFFE,E000) shall be encoded according to the rules conveyed by the Transfer Syntax.
Each Item of a Data Element of Value Representation SQ shall be encoded as a DICOM Standard Data Element with a specific Data Element Tag of Value (FFFE,E000).
This length shall include the total length of all Data Elements conveyed by this Item.

requirements.text: Undefined Length: The Value (Item) Length Field shall contain the value FFFFFFFFH to indicate an Undefined Length.

This Item Delimitation Data Element has a Data Element Tag of (FFFE,E00D) and shall follow the Data Elements encapsulated in the Item.

This length shall include the total length resulting from the sequence of zero or more items conveyed by this Data Element.

Private Creator Data Elements numbered (gggg,0010-00FF) (gggg is odd) shall be used to reserve a block of Elements with Group Number gggg for use by an individual implementer.
The implementer shall insert an identification code in an unused (unassigned) Element in this series to reserve a block of Private Elements.
The VR of the private identification code shall be LO (Long String) and the VM shall be equal to 1.

This implies that when a DICOM Data Set is being encoded with the DICOM Implicit VR Little Endian Transfer Syntax the following requirements shall be met:
The Data Elements contained in the Data Set structure shall be encoded with Implicit VR (without a VR Field) as specified in Section 7.1.3.
The encoding of the overall Data Set structure (Data Element Tags, Value Length, and Value) shall be in Little Endian as specified in Section 7.3.
The encoding of the Data Elements of the Data Set shall be as follows according to their Value Representations:

disposition.detail: A numeric Value's byte order is not observable: its bytes read as some valid Little Endian Value. Only Values with known ranges reveal swapping, and those are checked as their own statements (LUT Descriptors, Segmented Palette data)

requirements.text: For all Value Representations defined in this Part, except for the Value Representations OB and OW, the encoding shall be in Little Endian as specified in Section 7.3.
For the Value Representations OB, OL, OV and OW, the encoding shall meet the following specification depending on the Data Element Tag:
Pixel Data (7FE0,0010) has the Value Representation OW and shall be encoded in Little Endian.
Overlay Data (60xx,3000) has the Value Representation OW and shall be encoded in Little Endian.

disposition.detail: Implicit VR encodes no VR, so the OW a reader applies to Waveform Data cannot be contradicted by the bytes, and the byte order of its Values is not observable

requirements.text: Waveform Data (5400,1010) shall have Value Representation OW and shall be encoded in Little Endian.

Red Palette Color Lookup Table Data (0028,1201), Green Palette Color Lookup Table Data (0028,1202), Blue Color Palette Lookup Table Data (0028,1203) and Alpha Palette Color Lookup Table Data (0028,1204) have the Value Representation OW and shall be encoded in Little Endian.

Red Palette Color Lookup Table Descriptor (0028,1101), Green Palette Color Lookup Table Descriptor (0028,1102) and Blue Palette Color Lookup Table Descriptor (0028,1103) have the Value Representation SS or US (depending on rules specified in the IOD in PS3.3 PS3.3), and shall be encoded in Little Endian.
Data Elements (0028,1221),(0028,1222),(0028,1223) Segmented Red, Green, Blue Palette Color Lookup Table Data have the Value Representation OW and shall be encoded in Little Endian.
LUT Data (0028,3006) has the Value Representation US or OW and shall be encoded in Little Endian.
LUT Descriptor (0028,3002) has the Value Representation SS or US (depending on rules specified in the IOD in PS3.3 PS3.3), and shall be encoded in Little Endian.

disposition.detail: Implicit VR encodes no VR, so the OW a reader applies to Blending Lookup Table Data cannot be contradicted by the bytes, and the byte order of its Values is not observable

requirements.text: Blending Lookup Table Data (0028,1408) has the Value Representation OW and shall be encoded in Little Endian.

disposition.detail: Implicit VR encodes no VR, so the OL a reader applies to Track Point Index List cannot be contradicted by the bytes, and the byte order of its Values is not observable; reading it as unsigned binds readers

requirements.text: Track Point Index List (0066,0129) has the Value Representation OL and shall be encoded in Little Endian and is always interpreted as unsigned.

Open polylines and implicitly closed polygons shall have their vertices encoded in Point Coordinates Data (0066,0016) or Double Point Coordinates Data (0066,0022) in clockwise winding order when viewed from the top surface of the slide towards the bottom, per Section C.8.12.2.1.
